_meta.title: LoCoMo gold key schema + deterministic probe map for protocol v2 (full 2x2 experiment)
_meta.author_role: LoCoMo gold-schema + probe author (protocol-v2 design swarm, role C)
_meta.resolves: full_experiment_critique.md B7 (LoCoMo key schema, probe construction) under orchestrator pins V2-P2 (dyadic single-pass extraction; 20 speaker-stores; cluster unit = conversation n=10, speaker-substrate n=20 sensitivity), V2-P4 (no LLM answering layer: pre-mapped QA lookups, deterministic cat-5 key-absence scoring, supersession-history time-indexed probes), V2-P7 (gold authored now, freezes with protocol v2), V2-P9 (natural-first; 35 natural pairs = preregistered natural resolution endpoint).
_meta.verification: Every evidence pointer below was resolved against the raw dialog and its quote fragment + speaker asserted verbatim by the builder (scratchpad locomo_v2/build_all.py); every key's surrounding dialog was read by the author this session. locomo_analysis.md's inventory was NOT trusted blindly; corrections it needed are in locomo_schema_notes.md.
_meta.store_scope: One canonical store per (conversation, speaker) = 20 speaker-stores (V2-P2). entity = lowercase first name of the speaker within that store; third parties (samantha, rachel-style) are their own entities inside the focal speaker's store. Entities cannot collide across conversations.
_meta.dia_id_convention: D{session}:{turn}, both 1-indexed, exactly as in locomo10.json; session dates from session_N_date_time ('%I:%M %p on %d %B, %Y').
_meta.probe_question_rule: probe_question is generated from (entity, attribute) only and contains no candidate value string (pilot FM-4 ordering; builder-checked for proper-noun value tokens). Probes remain deterministic store lookups + blind equivalence judging (V2-P4).
_meta.first_mention_anchoring: For re-announcement chains (section 2.4 pathology) TTC anchors on the FIRST commit-licensing mention (new_evidence); re-announcements are listed in extra_evidence and must not move the anchor. Keys whose transition completed before the conversation start (transition_class=retrospective_at_first_mention with no in-dialog old-value period) are excluded from supersession-timing endpoints and serve current-state probes only.
_meta.freeze: Freezes with protocol v2 (V2-P7/V2-P10). Post-freeze changes require a research/protocol_changelog.md entry.
_meta.canonicalization: Pilot rules in research/key_schema.json 'canonicalization' apply unchanged (value normalization, key format), with the dyadic store_scope above replacing the per-substrate scope note.
